data.title: Wire Beneficiary Name Mismatch
data.description: Detects when the wire beneficiary name provided by the originator does not match the account holder name at the receiving institution. Name mismatches on wire transfers are a strong indicator of payment diversion fraud where funds are redirected to accounts controlled by the attacker.
falsepositives: Payments to businesses using a DBA (doing business as) name different from legal entity name
Wire transfers to joint accounts where one holder's name is provided
